notes.title: Hell Is Us lead says Silksong's short notice release date was "a little callous," even if he's happy they didn't delay it
notes.notes:
I think that no matter when Hollow Knight: Silksong released, it was going to ruffle some feathers. Not because of any of that difficulty discourse you've probably seen on your timeline since its release, we're done with that, I'm talking about its literal release date, September 4th. You probably saw several games delay themselves out of its window to be in with a fighting chance in this current media hellscape we have. But there was one notable release that stuck with its date, and that's Hell Is Us, which came out, oh dear, September 4th. And the game's creative director, Jonathan Jacques-Belletête, understandably has some feelings about that.

Read more

notes.title: HELL IS US – New Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]The Hell is Us demo is back! It will be available at 3 PM CEST / 6 AM PT.[/b][/p][p]
Months after its first appearance, the demo returns — now enhanced with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and refined gameplay to make your return to Hadea even smoother. Here’s what’s changed since the last time you played:[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🎥 New Camera Options[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Camera Follow[/b] toggle on/off.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement Lag[/b] and [b]Rotation Lag[/b] adjustments for smoother control.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📦 New Inventory Organisation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]Favorites[/b] and [b]Archives[/b] tabs for quicker access to your items.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]⚙️ New Difficulty Screen[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Choose your preferred difficulty level more easily.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📟 Optimisation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Graphics improvements — now playable in 4K at 60 FPS, among other enhancements.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📸 Photo Mode Added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Capture your most stunning moments directly in-game.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌍 Added Localisations[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]French voice-over[/b] now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Text language support for [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Japanese[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🗡️ Parry & Riposte Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While all attacks can be blocked, only certain attacks can now be parried, triggering a counter-attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]visual cue[/b] for parryable attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]dedicated tutorial[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Riposte camera sequence now only plays [b]once every 5 to 10 ripostes[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎯 Lock-On / Targeting Tweaks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added up/down switching when enemies, at the centre of the screen, are in front of one another.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother camera movement.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📟 Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Datapad full boot screen only shows the [b]first time[/b] you open it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple bug fixes[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various optimisations[/b] for better performance.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Whether you played the first demo or are discovering [b]Hell is Us[/b] for the very first time, now’s the perfect moment to jump back in and see what’s new.
We look forward to hearing your feedback — see you in Hadea.[/p]

notes.title: Community Update #3
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Looking Back on the Demo[/b] [/h3][p]First of all, we want to give a huge thank you to the [i][b]Hell is Us[/b][/i] community! [/p][p]After 5 years of development, it was truly special to finally see our game— even if just a small slice of it— in the hands of players. Excitement was at its peak within the walls of Rogue Factor: seeing the first online reactions, watching streamers and their audiences enjoy the experience— it reminded us why we do what we do! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zluAsOZj5KY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks to you—players and content creators—[i][b]Hell is Us[/b][/i] made it into the [b]Top 50 most played demos[/b] during Steam Next Fest! [/p][p]Many of you played, and many of you shared your feedback with us, whether here on Steam, on our Discord server, or elsewhere. [/p][p]We hear you, and we’re taking your comments seriously as we continue to improve the Hell is Us experience leading up to launch. [/p][p]Now, you’re part of the journey as we enter the final sprint toward [b]September 4th[/b], when you’ll be able to continue Rémi’s odyssey on [b]PC, PS5, or Xbox Series[/b]. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hell is Us is GOLD[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/ac95f56625e1f1f61781ea4a51a7ffa6736e916f.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re also excited to announce that [b]Hell is Us has gone GOLD! [/b]This means all technical certifications have been passed on consoles. Essentially, version 1.0 of the game is complete. It’s a major milestone for the team, and we’re incredibly proud! 

[/p][h3][b]Looking Back on the [i]Through the Lens of War[/i] Event[/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/45e5f512d6dd7333bf2b95e96d7a4fce4b69ecb2.jpg"][/img][/h3][p]Many of you took part in our [i]Through the Lens of War[/i] gaming photography event, and we were blown away by the results. In addition to the announced winners, we also shared some of our favorite screenshots

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1620730/view/578263105990038951?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][i][b]Report from Hadea[/b][/i][b] Event[/b] [/h3][p]Not into gaming photography? Prefer to express your creativity through writing? You have until [b]the end of the day [/b]to take part in the [i]Report from Hadea[/i] event. \[Click here] to learn how to participate and what you can win. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1620730/view/515213885413786779?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]What’s Next?[/b] [/h3][p]A lot of you are asking: [b]Where’s the console demo?[/b] [/p][p]No, we haven’t forgotten about console players. In fact, the team is working hard on it right now. We can’t promise or announce anything just yet—stay tuned! [/p][p] [/p][p]That’s all for now, Hadeans. See you next month! [/p]

notes.title: Community Update #2 – Press Tour, demo and more
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/1f723e6a1c29951e1435594771c14aeb03dec8fe.jpg"][/img]

Hello, community![/p][p]In our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1620730/announcements/detail/515209445812209435?snr=2___"]first community update[/url], we gave you a summary of everything that had been publicly released about [i]Hell is Us[/i] over the past year.[/p][p]Now that we’re approaching the release date of [b]September 4, 2025[/b] (just three months away!), communications are ramping up, and you’ll be hearing more and more about [i]Hell is Us[/i]—whether on our Discord, social media, in the press, or through content creators.[/p][h2]Hell is Us Press Tour[/h2][p]May was a big month for us in terms of meeting with the press and content creators during our North American and European press tours.[/p][p]The North American tour took place at our Rogue Factor offices in the Mile-End district of Montreal. Representatives from both international and local media, as well as content creators, responded to our invitation for a hands-on experience with [i]Hell is Us[/i]![/p][p]We could tell you more, but here’s a video that captures the energy of the event:[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OFb1dLGmJK8"]Hell is Us Press Tour - Rogue Factor, Montréal, Québec[/url]

[/p][previewyoutube="OFb1dLGmJK8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]No time to rest! We then packed our bags and headed to [b]Bigben Week[/b] in Paris, France, where European media and content creators got their turn to discover [i]Hell is Us[/i].[/p][p]At this event, our Creative Director and Art Director, Jonathan Jacques Belletête took the time to answer your questions posted on X :

[url="https://x.com/HellisUsGame/status/1929167887182205138/video/1"]Hell is Us (@HELLisUSgame) / X[/url][/p][h2]What did they think of the game?[/h2][p]Here is some of the coverages that the press and content creators published about their hands-on experience of Hell is Us![/p][p]"[i]Hell is Us is my most anticipated game for the rest of the year[/i]" - Greg Miller from Kinda Funny Games.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7LRDO-y9mNI"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]"[i]Still, I was very invested in the bizarre, new-weird setting that Rogue Factor has crafted, and it so far has the makings of being one of 2025's more original and creative takes on the action-RPG experience. [/i]" - Alessandro Fillari from IGN[/p][p][url="https://www.ign.com/articles/hell-is-us-brings-a-new-weird-approach-to-the-sci-fi-action-rpg"]Hell is Us Brings a 'New-Weird' Approach to the Sci-Fi Action-RPG - IGN[/url][/p][p]“[i]Hell is Us is a promising confluence of ideas. I enjoy the blend of Zelda-like dungeons, Elden Ring’s sense of discovery, and detective-style investigations and puzzle-solving. (...) Rogue Factor has carefully shaved opaqueness from its intentionally challenging puzzle design. This makes even the simplest problem-solving feel more rewarding[/i].” - Marcus Stewart from Game Informer[/p][p][url="https://www.gameinformer.com/preview/2025/05/30/show-dont-tell"]Hell is Us Preview - Show, Don't Tell - Game Informer[/url][/p][h2]Demo Available right now![/h2][p]Can’t wait to try the game yourself and forge your own opinion? You can! Until [b]June 16[/b], you can download the [i]Hell is Us[/i] demo for free on Steam.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1620730/Hell_is_Us/"]Download it here![/url][/p][p]This demo lets you explore the two core gameplay pillars: [b]combat[/b] and [b]investigation[/b]. You’ll get to explore the game’s first area, [b]Senedra Forest[/b], as well as part of the [b]Acasa Marshes[/b] map.[/p][p]If your PC is equipped with a 13th or 14th generation Intel CPU, we recommend checking out our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1620730/view/515211349279639742"]blog post about known issues with this hardware.[/url] 

Don’t forget to [url="https://discord.gg/Pf4GwRu6GD"]join our Discord[/url] server to give your feedback about the demo, discuss Hadean lore or read about any other known technical issue you may find answers to.[/p][h2]Pre-Order Your Deluxe Edition Metal Case now![/h2][p]To wrap up this update in style, here are a few images of the [b]physical Metal Case edition[/b] of [i]Hell is Us[/i], available for [b]PlayStation 5[/b] and [b]Xbox Series X|S[/b]![/p][p][i](Photos de la version Deluxe avec le metal case)[/i][/p][p]To get your hands on it, simply hop unto [url="https://www.nacongaming.com/en-US/hell-is-us"]Nacon Gaming’s website to pre-order.[/url][/p][p]The Deluxe Edition includes :[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img]An exclusive metal case[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img] The full game[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img]The game’s original soundtrack[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img]Cosmetic items for Remi, the game’s hero, and for KAPI, his drone[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img]A digital artbook[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img]A secret code giving access to special in-game content, which players will have to discover for themselves.[/p][p]That’s all for now—see you soon![/p]

notes.title: Hell is Us | Community Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/99a3c756c38f561d01b2078e88156b60bda644b4.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, 

Welcome to the very first Hell is Us Community Update! 

With this new format, we want to take a little time—at least once a month—to talk directly to you, as Rogue Factor, the people behind Hell is Us. Not from Hadea (thankfully), but from Montreal. A much calmer place... most of the time.  

Since this is the first edition, we’ll use the opportunity to go a bit beyond just “last month” and do a quick recap of where we’ve come from so far.  

[h2][b]FROM REVEAL TO TRAILERS[/b][/h2]

A lot has happened since our first reveal in April 2022. But let’s not rewind that far. Let’s start somewhere exciting: the two State of Play showcases. 

We were lucky enough to be featured in two of Playstation’s biggest events lately: 

First, with our Gameplay Reveal Trailer, where we introduced the world of Hell is Us — its tone, its world, and a few glimpses of what’s hiding beyond the Border. 

And later, with our Release Date Trailer, which focused more on Remi, the complex human at the center of all this. 

[b]Watch the Gameplay Reveal [/b]

[previewyoutube=ynk7LyKGNHM;full][/previewyoutube]

The goal was simple: give you a sense of what Hell is Us is all about — without showing too much. Because this is a game that’s better felt than explained. That said… we also knew you’d want to see more gameplay. 

[h2][b]EXTENDED GAMEPLAY EXPLAINED[/b][/h2]

So we followed it up with the Extended Gameplay video — a 15-minute walkthrough with our Creative Director and Art Director, Jonathan Jacques-Belletête (that we will call JJB from now on). 

[b]Watch the Extended Gameplay [/b]

[previewyoutube=Q69e1A3ovxI;full][/previewyoutube]

In it, JJB dives deep into a longer sequence that better shows what the game is really like to play — the mood, the pace, the tension, the danger. You responded better than we could’ve hoped, and that gave us even more motivation to keep refining what matters most. 

You also got a first taste of how the game balances two key pillars: Exploration and Combat. In our minds, it’s 50/50 — and the way you navigate between those two will shape your experience. 

Around the same time, we released a blog explaining one of our core philosophies: Player Plattering. 

This one’s close to our hearts. It’s a design idea born from our love for games that lets players figure things out for themselves — games that don’t over-explain, don’t hold your hand, and trust you to create your own meaning. That’s what we’re aiming for with Hell is Us. 

[b][url=https://blog.playstation.com/2024/09/24/hell-is-us-first-gameplay-of-the-ps5-action-adventure-out-2025/]Read the Player Platerring Blog[/url] [/b]

[h2][b]INTRODUCING REMI[/b][/h2]

Then there’s Remi — our protagonist. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/99885b15b16a5b7f22af25466154eaa3a5c495af.jpg[/img]

He’s… complicated. And we like him that way. He’s not a savior, not a chosen one, and definitely not invincible. He’s human. And throughout the game, he’ll evolve. 

We introduced Remi more properly in the Release Date Trailer, and announced he’s voiced by the incredible Elias Toufexis — the one and only voice of Adam Jensen in Deus Ex. It was a reunion with JJB (they’ve got history), and honestly? We can’t imagine anyone else in the role. 

You can follow Elias on X: https://x.com/EliasToufexis 
And yes, more content with him is coming soon!

[b]Release Date Trailer[/b]

[previewyoutube=8iZbNIAM8eQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re also working on a dedicated blog about Remi, so you can get a deeper sense of who he is — and who he isn’t. 

[h2][b]INVESTIGATION AT THE HEART OF THE EXPERIENCE[/b][/h2]

Most recently, we released the Investigation Trailer, which focused on an essential part of the game: how you make sense of what’s happening around you. 

We’d shown the world. We’d shown combat. But investigation is where the game opens up — where Player-Plattering really shines. 

Naturally, JJB returned for a 7-minute breakdown of how investigation works, how it connects to the world, and how it avoids feeling like a checklist. 

[b]Watch the Investigation Trailer [/b]

[previewyoutube=dH0oJyvku68;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]What’s Next? [/b][/h3]

If you’ve been following us, a lot of this might already sound familiar. But we’re not here just to recap the past. Here's a peek at what’s next: 

[b]Two upcoming dev blogs[/b] — including the one about Remi. They’ll dive deeper into the world,characters and share some of the thoughts that shaped the project. 

[b]Behind-the-scenes content[/b] — meet more members of the Rogue Factor team, see how things have evolved, and get to know the minds behind the game. 

And of course, we'd love you to follow us on our socials (links at the bottom) not only we will continuously share new content, but we love to discuss theories, make some challenges, and some might make you get your hands so some cool stuff, just saying… 

[h2][b]MAY, A BIG MONTH FOR HELL IS US[/b][/h2]

With some Press and Creators coming to Montreal to have a first experience of Hell is Us, and BigBen Week coming up in Paris in just a week,  we're starting to show the game to more and more people, and things are becoming much more concrete every day.
 
We’re just four months away from release — and things really start to accelerate. 

We couldn’t skip over everything we’ve done so far in this first Community Update, but future editions will focus more on the present: what we’re working on right now, what’s changing, and how the game is shaping up as we head toward launch.  You might even pick up on a few behind-the-scenes secrets along the way.

Thank you again for your continued interest in Hell is Us. Seeing players connect with our vision is what keeps us going every day. 
 
We can’t wait for you to finally get your hands on it. 

Until next time,
— The Hell is Us Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/4e4ab9653e764041d5c9a46ab85d67c5944922be.jpg[/img]

[h3]Follow us on our socials medias to take part in future community events.[/h3]

notes.title: The sci-fi adventure game from Deus Ex's art director now has Adam Jensen's voice actor, a September release date, and more techno-freak horror vibes than you can shake an augment at
notes.notes: I've been kind of jazzed for Hell Is Us since it was announced in 2022, in large part because the project is being headed up by Jonathan Jacques-Belletête—I loved his work as art director on Deus Ex: Human Revolution. (Yes, I am an unrepentant fan of the piss filter.) But then it fell off the radar for a couple years and I forgot about it until a surprise appearance in Sony's 2024 State of Play showcase, with a 2025 release target. And now, thanks to the most recent State of Play, we have a full-on release date: Hell Is Us will be out on September 4... Read more.
